name: Counter-Strike 1.6 · Scripted HLDS
description: Draft example: Valve HLDS with panel-owned Bash install/update scripts and shared base images. Not ReHLDS. Requires preloaded gamepanel-runtime:linux-v1 and gamepanel-installer:steamcmd-v1. Verify a disposable installation before publishing.
author: Skoczi
source: Valve SteamCMD / HLDS; panel-owned installation recipe

install.name: Download and verify Valve HLDS
install.script:
#!/bin/bash
[[ "$MAX_PLAYERS" =~ ^[0-9]{1,2}$ ]] && (( MAX_PLAYERS >= 1 && MAX_PLAYERS <= 32 )) || { echo 'Invalid player limit'; exit 2; }
[[ "$MAP" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid map'; exit 2; }
cd /opt/steamcmd
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
  if ./linux32/steamcmd +force_install_dir /data +login anonymous +app_set_config 90 mod cstrike +app_update 90 validate +quit; then
    if [[ -x /data/hlds_linux && -s /data/cstrike/dlls/cs.so && -s /data/cstrike/maps/de_dust2.bsp ]]; then
      mkdir -p /data/.steam/sdk32
      cp linux32/steamclient.so /data/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
      echo 'HLDS files verified'
      exit 0
    fi
  fi
  echo "Incomplete HLDS download, attempt $attempt"
done
echo 'HLDS installation incomplete; no game files deleted'
exit 1

update.name: Update HLDS without validate (backup first)
update.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Explicit update only. Publisher updates can replace files: back up first.
test -x /data/hlds_linux
cd /opt/steamcmd
./linux32/steamcmd +force_install_dir /data +login anonymous +app_set_config 90 mod cstrike +app_update 90 +quit
test -x /data/hlds_linux
test -s /data/cstrike/dlls/cs.so
test -s /data/cstrike/maps/de_dust2.bsp
mkdir -p /data/.steam/sdk32
cp linux32/steamclient.so /data/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
echo 'HLDS update verified'
